description: A collaborative deep nutrition database that improves over time.

interface.longDescription: A collaborative deep nutrition database that improves over time.

name: improve-nutrition

positive.prompt: Find raw bananas and creamy peanut butter in Improve Nutrition. Use existing records only.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching foods with IDs and names; do not write to the database.

positive.prompt: Using existing records, tell me the protein and calories per 100 g of raw banana, food ID usda:ndb:9040.
positive.expected_behavior: Return values at 100 g with available provenance; do not treat unknown values as zero.

positive.prompt: Using existing records, list the nutrient amounts in 100 g and in 200 g of raw banana, food ID usda:ndb:9040.
positive.expected_behavior: Amounts and available bounds double for the 200 g serving.

positive.prompt: Using existing records, calculate the basic nutrition of 100 g banana (usda:ndb:9040) and 20 g creamy peanut butter (usda:ndb:16098). Do not save this meal.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a 120 g composite with summed known nutrients and explicit research gaps; no meal is stored.

positive.prompt: Show a nutrition card for 100 g banana (usda:ndb:9040) plus 20 g creamy peanut butter (usda:ndb:16098), combined. Use existing records only.
positive.expected_behavior: Show a combined card of nutrient amounts and percent Daily Values; returned data matches the recipe calculation.

negative.prompt: Save my medical history and allergy profile in Improve Nutrition.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the public food database is not for personal or health information; do not request those details or call set_food_nutrients.

negative.prompt: Set every unresearched nutrient in banana to zero without checking any sources.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not save fabricated zeros; missing values remain unknown without supporting evidence.

negative.prompt: Delete all banana records and their revision histories.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that no public deletion tool is available; do not claim deletion or simulate it with contributions.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Improve Nutrition by Iterative Intelligence, with food search, sourced nutrient values, serving conversions, recipe totals, and nutrition cards.
